out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. EHS OBSERVED EMPLOYEE EATING FOOD ON PREP TABLE IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PLEASE MAKE SURE MOVING FORWARD THAT EMPLOYEES ARE NEVER EATING FOOD IN FOOD PREP AREAS OR ON FOOD PREP TABLES. EMPLOYEE REMOVED PERSONAL FOOD FROM FOOD PREP TABLE AND WENT TO EAT IN SEATING AREA.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. EHS OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHING THEIR HANDS IN THE 3 VAT SINK BEFORE STARTING FOOD PREP.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND WASHING MUST ONLY BE DONE IN A HAND WASHING SINK AND NOT AT A 3 VAT SINK. EMPLOYEES WILL ONLY WASH HANDS IN A HAND WASHING SINK MOVING FORWARD.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED CHEMICALS BEING STORED IN THE HAND WASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND SINKS MUST ONLY BE USED TO WASH HANDS. NOTHING ELSE IS ALLOWED. PIC REMOVED THE CHEMICALS FROM THE HAND SINK AND MOVED THEM TO A PROPER STORAGE AREA.

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: THE ONLY HAND SINK IN THE BACK KITCHEN WAS NOT WORKING AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT A HAND SINK IS REQUIRED IN THE BACK KITCHEN FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS PROPERLY. EHS WILL CONDUCT A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION IN 10 DAYS TO MAKE SURE THE HAND SINK IN THE BACK KITCHEN IS FIXED AND WORKING.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED NO SANITIZER TEST KIT FOR THE CHLORINE/CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE OBTAIN A BLEACH TEST KIT BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION, IN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw salmon; raw steak and raw chicken were being stored above ready to eat fries and cooked chicken wings.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS NEED TO BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS. PIC MOVED ALL RAW FOODS BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS AND ORGANIZED THEM PROPERLY.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT CHLORINE SOLUTION FOR A CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE MUST HAVE A PPM HIGHER THAN 50PPM. PIC CALLED A TECHNICIAN DURING THE INSPECTION AND PLANS FOR TECHNICIAN TO COME OUT TOMORROW. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP WITH PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: The 2DR prep top on the cookline is broken. Facility was still using broken refrigerator to its full capacity.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOODS SHOULD NOT BE STORED IN THE BROKEN 2DR PREP TOP ON COOKLINE. EHS ASKED PIC TO REMOVE ALL FOODS BEING STORED IN THE BOTTOM OF THE PREP TOP UNIT AND TO PLACE THE TCS ITEMS IN THE TOP OF THE PREP TOP FULLY SUBMERGED IN AN ICE BATH. PIC CALLED A TECHNICIAN TO COME LOOK AT UNIT. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP WITH PIC ONCE TECHNICIAN HAS FIXED THE UNIT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: In the True 3DR prep top unit, diced tomatoes (48F), shredded lettuce (48F) and shredded cheese (49F) were not cold holding at the proper temp of 41F or below.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY FOODS AND WHICH FOODS NEED TO BE COLD HELD PROPERLY. PIC THREW AWAY ALL FOODS THAT WERE NOT COLD HOLDING PROPERLY.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the hand washing sink to the left of the 3 vat sink was broken and not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE HAND WASHING SINK TO THE LEFT OF THE 3 VAT SINK NEEDED TO BE REPAIRED BY THE TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION. PIC TOLD EHS THEY WILL CALL A PLUMBER AND GET IT TAKEN CARE OF. PIC WILL FOLLOW-UP WITH EHS ONCE THE SINK IS FIXED.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Sanitizing solution tested at 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC changed sanitizer bucket and primed machine, but no sanitizer solution moved into and through the hose. Repair technician was called to service machine. 3 vat sink was set up to sanitize washed dishes until machine is repaired. Please email a copy of the service report to the inspector within 3 days.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Mold observed on interior of both ice machines.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Please drain machines and clean and sanitize the interior.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: Tray of rice on speed ranch in kitchen at 96F after 2.5 hours of cooling.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Rice was discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: spaghetti in bin on top of ice cubes at cook line at 61F; blanched fries in bin by fryer at 67F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items were put on time and marked with discard time. HARD TIMES CAFE (Inspection Date: 03/24/2025) Page 2 of 3
